element.name: Artifice Expertise
element.supports: GH Heritage Trait, GH Exploration Trait

description.p: Working with detritus and shattered objects has granted you an affinity for repairing and remaking things. You have proficiency with Tinker's Tools.

Additionally, you can use your Tinker's Tools and 10 GP worth of appropriate materials to spend 10 minutes creating a small clockwork device. The device must fit in the palm of your hand, and can serve one of the following functions:

ul.li: Smoker. The device exudes smoke in a 5-foot Cube for 1 minute. Any objects or creatures within this Cube are considered Lightly Obscured.
Lighter. The device emits a small flame the size of a candle's that can light flammable objects.
Compass. The device always points north, or in a cardinal direction of the GM's determination on another plane.

description.p: Improved version:

sheet.description: You can use your Tinker's Tools and 10 GP worth of materials to spend 10 minutes creating a small clockwork device (Smoker, Lighter, or Compass) that fits in the palm of your hand.

element.name: Expert Gadgeteer
element.supports: GH Heritage Trait, GH Combat Trait

description.p: You can make a device in 1 minute instead of 10 minutes. In addition, you can choose to imbue a device with the following extra function:

ul.li: Distractor. This device is set with blinking lights that can captivate other creatures. As a Bonus Action, you place or toss the device into a space within 30 feet of you. A creature sharing a space with the device must succeed on a DC 10 Intelligence saving throw. On a failure, attacks against that creature have Advantage until the start of your next turn. A creature can use an action to destroy the device.

description.p: You can give up to three of your devices the Distractor feature. You regain the ability to do so when you finish a Long Rest.

sheet.description: You can make your clockwork devices in 1 minute. Up to 3 times per Long Rest, you can imbue a device with the Distractor function. As a Bonus Action, you can place or toss a Distractor device into a space within 30 ft. A creature sharing its space must succeed on a DC 10 Int save or attacks against it have Advantage until the start of your next turn.

element.name: Artificial Form
element.supports: GH Heritage Trait, GH Exploration Trait

description.p: You were made, not born, and your unnatural origin forever marks you as different. You are a Construct, but your enchanted form still benefits from healing spells. You can also heal yourself by spending Hit Dice during Short Rests and Long Rests, as normal.
You don't need to eat, drink, sleep, or breathe. You must still be inactive for 8 hours during a Long Rest to gain its benefits.
Improved version:

sheet.description: You are a Construct, but still benefit from healing spells and Hit Dice. You don't need to eat, drink, sleep, or breathe. You must still be inactive for 8 hours during a Long Rest to gain its benefits.

sheet.description: When the Mending cantrip is cast on you, you can spend a Hit Die to regain HPs equal to the roll + {{constitution:modifier}} (minimum 1).

element.name: Awakened Mind
element.supports: GH Heritage Trait, GH Combat Trait

You automatically succeed on saving throws against magical effects that would give you the Incapacitated, Stunned, or Unconscious conditions. element.name: Breath Weapon
element.supports: GH Heritage Trait, GH Combat Trait

description.p: A connection to draconic or elemental fury lets you unleash a blast of destructive energy. When you select this trait, choose a damage type: Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, Poison, or Thunder. Then choose an area of effect: a Line that is 5 feet wide and 30 feet long, or a 15-foot Cone.

When you use a Magic action to expel your Breath Weapon, each creature in the area of effect must make a Dexterity saving throw (DC = 8 + your Constitution modifier + your Proficiency Bonus). A target creature takes 1d8 damage of the chosen type on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. This damage increases by 1d8 when you reach character levels 5 (2d8), 11 (3d8), and 17 (4d8).
You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus, regaining all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest.

element.name: Burst of Speed
element.supports: GH Heritage Trait, GH Exploration Trait

description.p: The many things that want to kill you must catch you first. On your turn, you can increase your Speed by 30 feet until the end of your turn. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus, regaining all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest.
Improved version:

element.supports: GH Heritage Trait, GH Exploration Trait

description.p: On a turn when you use Burst of Speed, you don't provoke Opportunity Attacks.

sheet.description: On a turn when you use Burst of Speed, you don't provoke Opportunity Attacks.

element.name: Calculating Listener
element.supports: GH Heritage Trait, GH Roleplaying Trait

description.p: The weak-willed around you are easy targets for your manipulation. By conversing with a nonhostile creature for at least 1 minute, you can attempt to charm them. The creature must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw (DC = 8 + your Charisma modifier + your Proficiency Bonus) or have the Charmed condition for 1 hour. At the GM's discretion, you also learn one piece of information that the target knows that relates to the topic of conversation while you speak to them. Regardless of whether or not the target succeeds on the saving throw, they remain unaware of your attempt. You regain use of this feature when you finish a Short or Long Rest.
Improved version:

sheet.description: By conversing with a nonhostile creature for at least 1 minute, you can attempt to charm them. The creature must succeed on a DC {{calculating listener:dc}} Wisdom saving throw or have the Charmed condition for {{calculating listener:duration}} hour. You may also learn one piece of information related to the topic. The target remains unaware of your attempt.

element.name: Master Manipulator
element.supports: GH Heritage Trait, GH Roleplaying Trait

description.p: A creature has Disadvantage on the saving throw, and it has the Charmed condition for 8 hours on a failed save.

sheet.description: When you use Calculating Listener, the creature has Disadvantage on the saving throw.

element.name: Centered
element.supports: GH Heritage Trait, GH Combat Trait

description.p: By focusing your inner strength, you gain a needed edge. As a Bonus Action, you grant yourself Advantage on an attack roll or ability check you make before the start of your next turn. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus, regaining all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest.
Improved version:

sheet.description: You grant yourself Advantage on an attack roll or ability check you make before the start of your next turn.

element.name: Centered Edge
element.supports: GH Heritage Trait, GH Combat Trait

description.p: When you succeed on the attack roll or ability check made while using Centered, you can choose one creature within 30 feet of you. That creature has Advantage on the next attack roll or ability check they make before the start of your next turn.

sheet.description: When you succeed on the attack roll or ability check made while using Centered, you can choose one creature within 30 feet of you to have Advantage on their next attack roll or ability check before the start of your next turn.

element.name: Charging Attack
element.supports: GH Heritage Trait, GH Combat Trait

description.p: The fury with which you throw yourself into battle forces your foes to feel your wrath. If you move at least 20 feet straight toward a target and then hit it with a melee attack with a weapon or an Unarmed Strike on the same turn, you can make another attack against the same target as a Bonus Action with the same weapon.
Improved version:

sheet.description: If you move at least 20 feet straight toward a target and then hit it with a melee attack with a weapon or an Unarmed Strike on the same turn, you can make another attack against the same target as a Bonus Action with the same weapon.

element.name: Furious Charge
element.supports: GH Heritage Trait, GH Combat Trait

description.p: When you use Charging Attack, you have Advantage on all attacks after the triggering movement until the end of your turn. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus, regaining all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest.

sheet.description: When you use Charging Attack, you have Advantage on all attacks after the triggering movement until the end of your turn.

sheet.description: You can use your Climb Speed to move up, down, and across vertical surfaces and upside down along ceilings, while leaving your hands free. While using climbing movement, you can Dash as a Bonus Action.

description.p: The history of Etharis is written in relics, and you read that history better than most. When you make a History check related to any object (an item, device, building, or material) and you have proficiency in an Artisan's Tool associated with creating that object, you are considered proficient in History and you add double your Proficiency Bonus to the check instead of your normal bonus.

sheet.description: Your reach increases by 5 feet. This extra reach doesn't apply to Opportunity Attacks.

element.name: Ruthless Response

sheet.description: You can take the Hide action even when you are only Lightly Obscured by foliage, heavy rain, falling snow, mist, and other natural phenomena.

Improved version:

sheet.description: Before you make an ability check using a skill you are proficient with, you can add your Proficiency Bonus again.

element.name: Stalwart Reserves

sheet.description: When you hit a creature with a melee attack, you can roll {{proficiency}}d4 and gain Temporary Hit Points equal to the total rolled.

element.name: Standing Leap

If your Speed is less than the distance you can Long Jump, you can leap only a distance equal to your Speed.
Improved version:

sheet.description: You can make a Long Jump of up to 20 feet and a High Jump of up to 10 feet, with or without a running start. If your Speed is less than the distance you can Long Jump, you can leap only a distance equal to your Speed.

element.name: Incredible Leap
element.supports: GH Heritage Trait, GH Exploration Trait

description.p: You can make a Long Jump of up to 30 feet and a High Jump of up to 15 feet, as limited by your speed.

Additionally, when you jump out of another creature's reach, the movement of the jump does not provoke Opportunity Attacks from that creature. You regain the use of this feature when you finish a Long Rest.

sheet.description: You can make a Long Jump of up to 30 feet and a High Jump of up to 15 feet, as limited by your speed. When you jump out of another creature's reach, the movement of the jump does not provoke Opportunity Attacks from that creature.

sheet.description: You have Advantage on saving throws against having the Prone condition.

sheet.description: Standing from Prone takes only 5 feet of movement. When you fail a saving throw against being knocked Prone, you can succeed on the save instead.

sheet.description: When you fail a saving throw, you can roll a d{{timely boon:dice}} and add it to the save, potentially turning it into a success.

element.name: Unnatural Healer
element.supports: GH Heritage Trait, GH Roleplaying Trait

description.p: Your innate healing abilities let you recover from some of the grimmest wounds. During a Long Rest, you can automatically reverse Grievous Wounds. Additionally, you can reattach any severed body parts (fingers, legs, tails, and so on), which are automatically restored at the end of the Long Rest. If your severed body parts aren't available, you can replace them with the same body parts of another creature of the same general anatomy as you. If you wish to intentionally swap out body parts with replacements, you can sever your own body parts with no pain or discomfort.

The ability to make use of unusual body parts (for example, giving yourself the taloned paw of a lion if you lose a hand) are left to the GM's discretion. In any event, swapping a severed body part for an unusual body part grants you no mechanical Advantages not covered by other traits.
Improved version:

sheet.description: During a Long Rest, you can automatically reverse Grievous Wounds and reattach any severed body parts (yours or a replacement).

element.name: Regenerative Healer
element.supports: GH Heritage Trait, GH Roleplaying Trait

sheet.description: During a Long Rest, you automatically reverse Permanent Wounds and can restore any severed body part as if subject to the Regenerate spell.
